name: Cloak of the Crusader
source: Pathfinder #103: The Hellfire Compact pg. 73, Gods and Magic pg. 55, Inner Sea Gods pg. 262
body:
Source Pathfinder #103: The Hellfire Compact pg. 73, Gods and Magic pg. 55, Inner Sea Gods pg. 262
Aura faint enchantment; CL 1st
Slot shoulders; Price 2,700 gp; Weight 1 lb.
Description
This brilliant red cloak bears a golden symbol of an upright winged sword. The wearer can use bless once per day.

If Iomedae is the wearer’s patron, the wearer gains a +1 enhancement bonus to her natural armor. As a standard action, the wearer can create an illusory image of Iomedae’s banner, which floats 2 to 5 feet above the wearer’s head and remains in place as long as the wearer is conscious. If the wearer has the bannerAPG class feature, she can use this battle standard as her banner.
Construction
Requirements Craft Wondrous Item, barkskin, bless, silent image; Cost 1,350 gp
